app.title: power-tv Theme Community
app.description: Discover, publish, and download themes for power-tv 1.5.0 and later.

footer.tagline: Discover, share, and manage your TV themes.

home.heroDescription: Discover, share, and download themes for power-tv 1.5.0 and later. Every theme contains only colors, fonts, and layout data, so it is safe and easy to install.
